connector.notes: Sales orders and purchase orders sent from the app are now accepted by TallyPrime. Receipts from the app are entered credit first, the way TallyPrime shows them. Not mandatory: an older connector keeps working, but it cannot receive orders.

android.notes: Sales orders and purchase orders now go into TallyPrime. Add CGST, SGST or IGST to a sale or order from your Tally tax ledgers. Picking an item fills its unit and rate, and receipts and payments offer your cash and bank accounts.
